slides.notes: Clarifying a concept - You can use this prompt

slides.title: Clarifying a Concept
slides.body:
Prompt
Act as if you are an expert with 20 years of experience in developing static websites with HTML & CSS. I am learning about {Topic name}. I am specifically confused about {doubt}. Please clarify this specific point for me and break down the explanation into smaller, easier-to-understand parts. Use simple analogies, real-world examples to simplify the concept and simplify everything as if I were 5 years old.
slides.notes:
If you have doubts while learning a concept related to static Website and need immediate clarification, GenAI can provide quick answers.
And also Even if you're hesitant to ask questions, feel free to use AI to resolve your doubts and gain clarity.

For Example:  You are having doubt having how to write multiple paragraph elements? Like p1, p2 or just p. You can ask it.
Lets try this out..

If you see, its providing us detailed explanation of our doubt. 
But some of us might prefer asking questions to check our understanding and to get more clarity right!

slides.title: Clarifying a Concept
slides.body:
Prompt
Let’s dive into learning Static Website HTML/CSS, a {Topic name} I am really curious about! I would like you to ask me questions to help me explore and understand this subject better. We will work together to build a solid foundation, and you will provide feedback to help me identify any misconceptions or gaps in my understanding—kind of like using the Feynman technique.
Feel free to ask specific questions that challenge my understanding of HTML and CSS. It doesn’t matter if I can’t answer them right away; my goal is to learn and improve more and more.                     Let’s begin!
slides.notes:
You can use this prompt for that. It asks questions on a specific concept in different ways to deepen your understanding and also helps you to identify the gaps in your understanding.
Lets try the paragraph element again here..

Similarly, you can change the prompt, add your preferences in learning, so that you can understand, clear your doubts in a better way.

slides.notes:
Now you have understood the concept. But you want to test yourself, whether your understanding is correct and your knowledge is sufficient enough.
For this, we are already giving MCQs and coding questions to you in learning portal right!
You might understand well and resolve all your doubts, your practised mcqs and coding questions. You are strong on it.
But sometimes, you find out that a concept is interesting to you, and want to know it further. What you need to do? You need to learn by yourself.
This is the essential skill for any developer. You will learn new things daily once you become a developer as well. Let's improve this skill further.
In those cases, Testing your knowledge is very important. Lets see, how we can test our knowledge with genai..

slides.title: Testing your Knowledge
slides.body:
Prompt
I just finished learning about {Topic name}. Could you create a comprehensive quiz to test my understanding of this concept by following these guidelines:
- Present each question one at a time, in sequential order.
- Wait for my response after each question before moving to the next one.
- Provide immediate feedback after each answer, including detailed explanations and reasoning behind the correct answer.
- Track my progress throughout the quiz and let me know how I am doing at each step.
- If I get an answer wrong, kindly provide hints or further resources to help me                                    understand the concept better.
slides.notes:
You can use this prompt for that.
Let's test our understanding on a button element now with MCQs.

- - -

Sometimes, the GPT might not give you the correct output. Because it doesn’t know about you, your background, your current knowledge.
Also, it depends on how well we are giving the instructions right!

Right now, let see the the questions that are relevant to us, for the questions which contains newer concepts, you can ignore them.

slides.title: Testing your Knowledge
slides.body:
Prompt
You are an HTML and CSS tutor for school and first-year engineering students. Your goal is to ask one coding question on static website at a time based on the provided concepts.Concepts : {Topic name}Guidelines:- Ask one detailed question at a time based only on the concepts explicitly mentioned.- Do not introduce any new concepts or elements unless it has explicitly included.- Increase the difficulty of the question using variations but do not introduce new concepts.- Whenever a layout-based question is asked, provide a clear layout outline   (diagram or text).- Evaluate the answered code based on correctness, structure,    and sticking to the concept.- Provide constructive feedback and improvements.- Only proceed to the next question once i answered the question correctly and   with sufficient understanding.

slides.title: AI Tools
slides.body:
Perplexity
Perplexity is a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question
slides.notes:
It's not just about answering questions; it's about empowering you to do more—whether you're looking to summarize content, explore new topics, or even get a little creative.

https://www.perplexity.ai/: Open and show the sections

slides.title: Perplexity
slides.body:
Key Features
Direct, Contextual Answers
Source Citations for Trust and Deeper Learning
Real-Time, Up-to-Date Information
Follow-up Questions for Deeper Understanding
SOURCE
slides.notes:
Answering questions: From basic facts to tough questions—and get answers from up-to-date sources. Create code, summarize articles, or emails—all in one place.
Exploring topics in depth: Perplexity Pro Search feature provides a guided Al search experience, allowing you to explore topics in depth and learn new things.
Organizing your Library: Organize your Threads in Perplexity Spaces by project or topic. Invite contributors and easily switch privacy settings.
Interacting with your data: Ask questions about your files and search the web, all without leaving the platform. Get a complete project view in one space.

slides.title: AI Tools
slides.body:
NotebookLM
NotebookLM is an experimental AI-first notebook developed by Google
slides.notes:
https://notebooklm.google/: Open and show the sections

NotebookLM is an experimental AI-first notebook developed by Google. It uses the documents you upload to train a specialized AI. 
The AI in that notebook then becomes an expert on your documents, giving you an invaluable resource, specific to your needs. 
Even if you give 300-page book and you will get back study guides, summaries, and even a podcast of all the information.

The main purpose is to help you engage with your specific learning materials.

slides.title: NotebookLM
slides.body:
Key Features
Creates Mind maps
Answers from uploaded sources
Creates Podcasts
Analyse multiple content formats
Provides Citations
Creates Study Guides, etc
slides.notes:
Gives answers from what you upload:  
- You can give NotebookLM your notes, documents, or videos and It reads them and gives you answers when you ask questions.
Creates mind maps
- It shows ideas in the form of a map, where everything is connected. And This helps you understand big topics in a simple way.
Understands different types of content
- It can read PDFs, Google Docs, YouTube videos, and even web links and You don’t need to copy everything — just upload, and it understands.
Creates podcasts
- It can turn your notes into small audio stories or talks and You can listen and learn instead of reading everything.
Makes study guides
- It picks out the important points from your content. and You get a short and easy guide to revise or learn from.
Provides citations
- When it gives an answer, it tells you exactly where it got the information from. So you can check and trust what it says.


Let’s see how to use NotebookLM for the scenarios we discussed above:

AI tools can help you write code faster, but they should not replace your understanding
slides.notes:
We need to use gen ai effectively such that it improves your technical understanding and skills as a developer.

As said earlier, Technical understanding is really essential for us as a developer, to add more functionality to the existing code, and to work on multiple files of code, etc right!And also, like some of the skills, which we discussed, understanding code, self learning, problem solving, etc - which are essential for you as a developer.

Lets use gen ai to improve the technical understanding and to improve the skills. But not to just complete it. It will be of no use for us. Its also in our hands, to use this effectively, whether to improve our learning, to replace learning.

Lets always use it to improve our learning like we discussed earlier in few scenarios.
